# CHANGELOG

- Added new function to get srcset of the image in 'inc/srcset'
- Renamed function to preload images in head to 'forqy_image_preload' and hooked to 'forqy_head_pre' with fallback

## [1.0.7] — 2025-04-09

- Getting SVG file width & height using 'wp_remote_get' in 'svg.php:39'

## [1.0.6] — 2025-03-03

- Improved getting the ID of the current page/post for preload in 'inc/preload.php'

## [1.0.5] — 2025-02-07

- Improved getting of the width & height attributes in 'forqy_lazy_image_attributes'

## [1.0.4] — 2025-01-04

- Added preload of the webp versions of images
